title: ranunculus constantinopolitanus var. villosus
intro: Ranunculus constantinopolitanus var. villosus, commonly known as the hairy lesser celandine, is a flowering plant in the buttercup family (Ranunculaceae). This plant is known for its yellow flowers and hairy leaves, and is native to Europe. The hairy lesser celandine has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including treating wounds, reducing inflammation, and relieving respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of the plant include ranunculin, which is responsible for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties.
